## What's Changed
### Fixes 🔧
* Fix removing a submodule in a linked worktree breaking the submodule in the main worktree by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6186
* Ignore submodules whose name or path in .gitmodules leads outside the repository by @stefanhaller in https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/pull/6187


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/compare/v0.66.2...v0.66.3
